short: A short round is available while more history is verified.
ready: The shared Timeline engine is ready to play.

workshopNote: This club's games are being built from its own history. Each one opens once its facts are sourced.

fallback: This language is not available yet. The interface is shown in English.
paused: This club is taking a short break.
closed: Timeline is currently closed by the administrator.
lifeOpen: Grow up with the club: the street, the people, the match day.
lifeWorkshop: This club’s LIFE is still being written — from its own streets, songs and match days.
credit: Set in type & built by Dubel Team
creditAria: Dubel Team — set in type and built by (opens in a new tab)
coverTag: The weekly paper of the people's game
coverSub: Every club, no favourites. One archive.
nextNote: Real fixtures from a public feed, every club on the roll. No confirmed date, no invented one.
nextDown: The fixture feed is not answering. Nothing is guessed.
letterBody: Every fact in this paper has a source. If we cannot prove it, it is not printed — not the score, not the scorer, not the date.
meetingsNone: No meeting between these two clubs is in the archive yet. We print nothing we cannot source.
psBody: Final whistle on every page: no favourites, no rumours, no yellow cards in the paper.
lifeEntryNote: Live one fan's seasons — from the first match holding someone's hand to the one you'll never forget.
sourcesNote: Each club's facts, grouped by the publisher that recorded them. Titles appear in the language they were published in.
creditsBody: FAN LIFE is an independent supporters' project. Club names and colours belong to their clubs; no club endorses this site.
homeLead: {club} supporters, this is your end of the ground: the games, the shirts and the stories, all from {club}'s own history.
homeColoursNote: The colours you grew up with, on every page of this club.
lostTitle: This page is not in the paper
lostBody: The link may be old, or the page has moved. The clubs and the games are all one tap away.
errTitle: This page went to press with a fault.
errBody: Nothing you did. Try it again — if it happens twice, the page is being fixed.
swapTitle: Swap the shirt. Keep the colours.
swapBody: Every club here is a world of its own. Visit another supporter's end of the ground — and bring your own colours with you.
tbcLine: The next match isn't confirmed yet.
letterBody2: Every club here keeps its own colours. Nobody is the default, nobody is the opposition — until you walk into their end of the ground.
letterBody3: Pick your club, play its gates, and mark the days you were there. The rest is ninety minutes and a lifetime.
beenBody: The night the ground shook. The final you still talk about. Mark the matches you saw with your own eyes — in a club's archive or its meetings — and they go into your story, in order, on your card.
cornerTitle: Your card. Your closet. Your swaps.
cornerBody: A supporter's card with your number on it, a closet for the shirts you own and the ones you're after, a market to swap or sell them, and an auction for the special ones. Prices in euros.
beenHint: Mark it: it goes into Me → My story
clubBeenBody: Every match and moment in the {club} archive carries a stamp: I was there. Press it on the days you saw — they go into your story, on your card.
shirtsLead: Every {club} shirt on record — look them up, mark the ones you own, sell or swap.
shirtsArchiveNote: Photos of every shirt, season by season.
shirtsOwnNote: Mark a shirt and it goes into your closet.
shirtsSellNote: List a shirt from your closet, or find one. No fees.
shirtsAuctionNote: One shirt, one window, one winner.
